newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Thomson BankWatch upgrades Russia to B+ from B.
newsitem.headline: Thomson BankWatch upgrades Russia to B+ from B.

text.p: Thomson BankWatch said it had upgraded sovereign risk rating for the Russian Federation to B+ from B, and had also upgraded the long-term senior debt ratings for four Russian banks.

"This rating adjustment is based on the important strides the government has made in recent months on the fiscal front, in bringing down inflation, stabilising the exchange rate, and spurring a turnaround in economic growth," Thompson said in a statement.

Thompson also upgraded Bank Menatep, Far Eastern Bank, Rossiskiy Kredit Bank, and Vozrozhdeniye Bank to B+ from B and it said the change was possible because of its changed Russian sovereign risk rating.
Vorozhdeniye and Menatep were both given B ratings last month. Both banks plan to issue Level One American Depositary Receipts soon.
Thompson BankWatch issues ratings on financial institutions in over 80 countries worldwide.
